channel.title: GTAVITIPS — GTA 6 News
channel.description: GTA 6 news and intel from official Rockstar sources. Characters, vehicles, locations, and everything moving in Leonida.

item.title: Every Confirmed Character in GTA 6
item.description: 16 confirmed characters across three tiers. Protagonists, underworld connections, and the public figures who make Vice City feel occupied.

item.title: Trailer 3: What's Real and What's Noise
item.description: No date, no teaser, no countdown. What Rockstar has actually put on the record, the window everyone points at, and the rumors that already fell apart.

item.title: PlayStation and Rockstar: GTA VI Plays Best on PS5
item.description: Sony and Rockstar confirm a close partnership. DualSense, Tempest 3D Audio, SSD. Plus: the social media campaign that disappeared and came back the same day.

item.title: GTA VI Pre-Orders Open Tonight.
item.description: Two editions. Standard at $79.99, Ultimate at $99.99. Pre-orders open at midnight on June 25. Everything Rockstar confirmed, broken down.

item.title: GTA 6 Trailer 2: Everything We Saw
item.description: Three minutes of Leonida. Shot by shot. Everything visible in Rockstar's May 2025 trailer, described as it appeared.

item.title: GTA 6 Trailer 1: Everything We Saw
item.description: 91 seconds of Leonida. Shot by shot. Everything visible in Rockstar's December 2023 trailer, described as it appeared.

item.title: GTA 6 Lands on Xbox Store. Wishlist Live.
item.description: Xbox posted the key art on May 22. The store page lists November 19. No pre-orders yet, just a wishlist button and a date already on the calendar.

item.title: Best Buy Lists GTA 6 Pre-Order Before Rockstar Says a Word
item.description: Best Buy put GTA 6 up for pre-order with a November 19 date before any official announcement. The listing is down. The date stuck.

item.title: Strauss Zelnick: GTA 6 Expectations Are Terrifying
item.description: Take-Two's CEO on record. The expectations are unlike anything they have seen. His exact words.

item.title: The Brands of Vice City: In-World Commerce as World Building
item.description: 50 confirmed brands. Every product category. The brand ecosystem is Vice City's self-portrait. Here is what it says.

item.title: The Criminal Economy of Vice City: How It Works
item.description: Product enters at Port Gellhorn. It moves through the OMG corridor. It distributes through Real Dimez and San 4 San. Money comes back clean.

item.title: The Geography of Leonida: A Reconstruction
item.description: Five confirmed zones. No official map yet. This is the spatial logic of Leonida reconstructed from confirmed locations, trailer geography, and aerial footage.

item.description: No official DLC announced. The infrastructure arguments, the geographic candidates, and the commercial logic examined.

item.title: GTA 6 PC System Requirements: What to Expect
item.description: No PC release date confirmed. Analysis of what the console specs and Leonida visual targets imply for PC hardware requirements.

item.description: Confirmed is not a casual word here. This is the complete credibility system behind every label in the database.

item.description: Targeting launch day. Confirmed locations now, full in-game coordinates at launch. Database-integrated and mobile-ready.

item.description: The database goes live on launch day. Here is exactly what happens on November 19 and how the site grows from there.

item.description: 80+ confirmed vehicles across every category. The fleet is not a menu of fast cars. It is the transport infrastructure of a functioning state.
